card.summary: A responsive client-facing bakery website built with reusable React components, data-driven content and interactive menu features.

media.coverAlt: Patisserie 4 You homepage with coffee-bean hero image, navigation and bakery name.

caseStudy.overview: Selected Client Work: Patisserie 4 You is a responsive bakery website developed around real business content, visual identity and customer-facing requirements. The public site brings menu content, business information and contact details together in one interactive page.
caseStudy.context: Selected Client Work: The project translated approved bakery content and visual assets into a responsive customer-facing website while keeping the public presentation concise and easy to explore.
caseStudy.problem: Bakery products, brand content and business information needed to be presented clearly across mobile, tablet and desktop screens without fragmenting the experience across multiple pages.
caseStudy.challenge: The implementation combined a media-rich visual presentation with usable navigation, filtering and favourite interactions across representative viewport sizes, while respecting reduced-motion preferences and handling browser storage safely.
objectives: Present bakery products and business content clearly
Provide usable desktop and mobile navigation
Make menu exploration interactive through category filtering
Retain favourite selections locally in the browser
Preserve the bakery's public visual identity across screen sizes
approach: Composed the active page from reusable React sections and cards
Centralised shared navigation, menu and contact content
Built responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS utilities
Added Framer Motion interactions with reduced-motion handling
Refined native controls, keyboard focus and mobile-menu state
Verified the result through linting, production builds and manual runtime checks
caseStudy.solution: The completed React single-page experience combines a branded hero, filterable menu cards, business-story sections, mission media, expertise, review and contact content. Desktop and mobile navigation connect the sections, while favourite controls persist selected menu items in browser storage with defensive fallback behaviour.
accessibility: One meaningful page-level heading structures the active page
Main, navigation and section landmarks support page structure
Links and buttons use native keyboard-operable controls
Visible focus styling supports keyboard navigation
The mobile menu exposes labels, expanded state and its controlled region
Escape closes the mobile menu and returns focus to its trigger
Reduced-motion preferences affect animation, scrolling and video playback
Active images use contextual or intentionally empty alternative text
testing: ESLint completed successfully with zero warnings
The Vite production build completed successfully
The production preview responded with HTTP 200
Manual responsive checks passed at 1280 x 800, 768 x 1024 and 375 x 812
Desktop and mobile navigation, keyboard focus and Escape behaviour were checked manually
Category filtering and favourite add, remove and reload persistence were checked manually
Reduced-motion behaviour, console output and failed network requests were checked manually
technicalImplementation: App.jsx composes the active single-page experience
Reusable React components render sections and prop-driven menu cards
Shared constants supply navigation, menu, contact and social content
Local React state manages filters, navigation and favourite controls
A dedicated utility parses and persists favourite identifiers safely
Tailwind CSS utilities provide responsive layout and presentation
Framer Motion provides interactions and reduced-motion support
Vite and ESLint provide the build and code-quality pipeline
The production site is publicly deployed on Netlify
caseStudy.result: A publicly deployed responsive bakery website with working section navigation, interactive menu filtering, persistent browser-local favourites and verified desktop, tablet and mobile presentation.
outcomes: Lint and production build checks pass
Representative desktop, tablet and mobile layouts are verified
Keyboard, focus and reduced-motion behaviour were improved and checked
Reusable components and shared data provide a maintainable page structure
limitations: Favourites remain local to the current browser
The site has no user accounts or server-side persistence
No automated test suite is currently configured
Large image and video files remain a performance optimisation opportunity
nextSteps: Optimise large image and video assets
Add an automated component or end-to-end test suite
Review and incorporate future approved client content updates
